title: [Master]-Act Consumption Qty field in Component of a Firm Planned Order has amounts that point to a Released Production Order that has the same Document No if the component is the same
summary: Production order component line pages now properly link component consumption quantities to their originating production order when a firm planned order contains components with the same item number.
key_points: Fixes incorrect consumption quantity references for components in firm planned orders
Clarifies which production order a component's quantities point to when duplicate items exist
Updates both the Component Line List page and the Components page
Includes test coverage for the scenario
